articles.title: PM Modi congratulates Skyroot after private rocket reaches orbit: ‘You have planted new seeds in the sky’
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi congratulated Skyroot Aerospace co-founder and CEO Pawan Kumar Chandana and his team after their rocket successfully reached orbit. PM Modi lauded the achievement as a significant moment, marking a major milestone for India in the private space sector. This success highlights the nation's growing capabilities in advanced rocket technology and space exploration, solidifying its position on the global stage.

articles.title: ISRO, SCTIMST to take up research in Bioastronautics
articles.summary: SCTIMST and ISRO's Human Space Flight Centre (HSFC) have partnered to advance research and training in space medicine and human spaceflight. This collaboration aims to develop critical medical support systems, technologies, and protocols for astronauts, enhancing India's capacity for manned space missions. It focuses on ensuring astronaut health and safety during long-duration space explorations, contributing significantly to the nation's ambitious Gaganyaan program.

His guidance suggests that maintaining steady effort and dedication throughout the preparation journey is key to achieving top ranks in competitive examinations. This insight from a high-achiever serves as valuable motivation for students aiming for success in challenging national entrance tests.

articles.title: Skyroot's Vikram-1 beats SpaceX in 1st attempt: How Pawan Kumar Chandana's team achieved what even Elon Musk couldn't in three tries
articles.summary: Skyroot Aerospace successfully launched its Vikram-1 rocket from Sriharikota, achieving a historic milestone as India's first privately developed rocket. This successful mission signifies a major leap for the nation's burgeoning private space sector, demonstrating indigenous capability and paving the way for enhanced private participation in space exploration and commercial satellite launches. This development further strengthens India's position in global space technology.

articles.title: Spacetech unicorn Skyroot launches Vikram-1, marks India's first private orbital rocket mission
articles.summary: Hyderabad's Skyroot Aerospace launched Vikram-1, becoming the first private Indian company to attempt placing payloads into orbit. This marks a significant national milestone, showcasing India's private space sector capabilities and indigenous rocket technology. It paves the way for future commercial space missions, bolstering India's global leadership in the rapidly evolving space industry.
